brief: A zero-entry iOS app that turns Apple Health workout history into a 52-week volume heatmap with automatic PRs and muscle recovery. It should feel exact, earned and quiet, like an engraved banknote or a clinical chart strip, not like a gym or a neon fitness tracker.
criteria: Success: distinct from flame, ring, dumbbell and neon fitness marks; no sound-volume reading; recognisable at 16 px; works in one colour.

concepts.name: Engraved Pulse
concepts.idea: One heartbeat, engraved in three lines, whose deep dip is the V of Volume.
rationale: Banknote engraving + chart-strip heartbeat: the app's own visual language
Rose live line over intaglio-blue engraved lines mirrors PR rose and volume ink
Small cut with two heavier lines keeps it legible at 16 px
Avoids flames, rings, dumbbells and speaker icons

recommendation: Engraved Pulse: chosen direction. Use the full mark from 48 px up and the small cut below it.
next_steps: Extend the engraved lines into a pattern for the share card and splash
